rules.question: Where on the Path Builder's screen is a moment of the song drawn, and how are the timeline's marks drawn?
rules.owner: ui::PreviewTimeline in src/ui/preview_timeline.h, the Preview's timeline, which places every mark through the window's fraction (ui/timeline_view.h) and draws its star glyph with ui::draw_star
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md (removed; git show 307d0b5c:docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md), PB-5 "Scan rows", approved by the user on 2026-10-30 ("Yes, as recommended")
must_match: dl->AddLine(ImVec2(x, y0), ImVec2(x, y1), ImGui::GetColorU32(ui::kAccentColor), ui::px(1.0f));
rules.note: The Path Builder's timeline is the Preview's (ui::PreviewTimeline, task PV-3), so the builder's own files place nothing by song time and paint nothing on a draw list: a draw-list call or a song_fraction call under src/pathbuilder is a second timeline. The one exception is the star glyph the screen draws beside the sentences that count saved phrases, as the user chose on 2026-10-30: it calls ui::draw_star, which lives with the timeline, so a line calling it passes even though it reaches the window's draw list to hand it over. The highway's ImGui::Image is not a draw-list call and is not flagged. A scope names a top folder or a single file (OwnerRule::scope), so the row lists each file under src/pathbuilder; a new file there joins the list. Decided by: the PB-5 scan rows in the plan.
